what: 2Q-B §2 — enstrüman ve olay envanteri, koddan okundu

instruments.eventRepresentation: DrumSlot: DrumHit[] — { piece, velocity?, articulation?: normal|ghost|accent }

answers.1. Can a drum event carry velocity today: Yes — `velocity?` is in the contract, and it reaches the sounding gain through NotatedDrum → DrumEventPlan.gain.
answers.2. Can different pieces share one tick?: Yes — a slot is an array of hits, so kick and snare coexist at one tick.
answers.3. Can the same piece be written twice a: The schema permits it (an array with no uniqueness rule). Nothing musical is gained and the second hit is inaudible under the first, so the entry command refuses it as `target_occupied` rather than writing a duplicate.
answers.4. Does a pitched track need an explicit: No — and it must not have one. A fretless instrument has no string to name; `keyboard-voicing.ts` already writes pitch alone.
answers.5. Which instruments can the keyboard vo: Every harmonic track without a fretboard: piano, electric_piano, organ, strings, synth
answers.6. Is there a numeric range for pitched: No. `keyboard-voicing.ts` records the decision and its reason: an invented low note is worse than an honest gap, so the only bound checked is what the Song Contract can spell (/^([A-G])(#|b)?(-1|[0-9])$/).
answers.7. Does the existing chord command accep: Yes — `isHarmonicTrack` asks only that the track is not a kit, and `chordVoicings` branches to the keyboard stack when there is no fretboard.
answers.8. How does preview behave against prese: A preset with no vendored pack is not offered as an ordinary choice (K-54) and cannot be previewed. Every pitched instrument is in this position today: piano, electric_piano, organ, strings, synth — so a pitched note sheet must write without offering Dinle.
answers.9. Is the drum kit a sampler or synthesi: A sampler: the kit's pieces resolve to sample files through the shared bank, the same path every other instrument uses.
answers.10. Why does the tab editor refuse drums: `isEditableTrack` is `!isDrumInstrument && fretboard !== undefined`. It is a fret-cell editor: a kit has no strings and a piano has no fretboard, so the refusal is honest — what is missing is a *different* surface for each, which is this checkpoint.

consequencesForThisCheckpoint: Davul girişi bugünkü Contract ile tamamen yazılabilir: parça, velocity ve normal/ghost/accent zaten var.
Pitched girişi de yazılabilir — nota pitch'ten ibarettir ve position yazılmaz.
Ama okur bugün pitched track *oluşturamaz*: bütün fretsiz enstrümanlar phase_2_5 kapsamında ve create_track core dışını reddediyor. Pitched giriş yalnız dosyadan gelen bir track için ulaşılabilir.
Hiçbir pitched enstrümanın vendor edilmiş sample'ı yok, yani pitched nota yazılabilir ama duyulamaz; Dinle kapalı olmalı ve bu söylenmelidir.
